brief_item.title: GORGO：跨地域网络感知LLM服务的在线调优代理
brief_item.direction_name: 跨域一致性、安全与多租户隔离
brief_item.core_conclusion: 全球分布的LLM推理代理需同时考虑KVCache局部性、副本负载与网络时延，现有策略只评估部分因素导致负载与缓存分布不均。GORGO是统一建模网络时延、prefill成本与排队时延的代理架构，用进化策略离线学习参数后固定，p95 TTFT较基线改善6.9-15.5%、p95端到端时延改善14.3-30.9%。
brief_item.mechanism: 代理用可调参数整体权衡网络时延、prefill成本与队列时延；基于合成长上下文数据集ART-Chat-2.5M（源自生产元数据）的调优窗口，用进化策略引导参数优化p95 TTFT，参数离线学习后在评测期保持固定。
brief_item.result: 相对会话亲和与prefix-cache策略，p95 TTFT提升6.9-15.5%，p95端到端时延提升14.3-30.9%（留出评测窗口、固定学习参数）；发布ART-Chat-2.5M合成数据集与代码（CC BY 4.0）。
brief_item.boundary: 评测使用合成数据集而非真实在线流量；摘要级证据，完整流量模式与跨厂商泛化需正文；代码与数据集已发布但未在此核验。
brief_item.project_relevance: [判断]直接命中跨域与KVCache路由：在地理分布推理中联合优化KVCache局部性、网络时延与排队时延，其整体调优方法与prefix-reuse数据集对多地域服务与KVCache传输调度具有可操作性。

facts.title: GORGO: Online Tuning for Cross-Region Network-Aware LLM Serving
facts.event_hint: Proxy architecture that jointly tunes network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay for cross-region LLM serving, improving p95 TTFT and E2E latency double-digit percent over baselines; releases ART-Chat-2.5M dataset.
facts.problem: LLM inference services increasingly proxy client requests to engine replicas distributed globally. Load-balancing policies must jointly consider KV-cache locality, replica load, and variable network latency to optimize latency and TTFT, but existing systems evaluate only a subset of these factors, causing uneven load and KV-cache distribution. Existing datasets also lack long-context, high prefix-reuse data needed to evaluate such systems.
facts.mechanism: GORGO is a proxy architecture that holistically factors network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay using tunable parameters. Evolutionary strategies on a tuning window derived from a synthetic dataset (ART-Chat-2.5M, built from long-context production metadata) guide GORGO's parameters to optimize p95 TTFT. Parameters are learned offline then held fixed during evaluation.

evidence.claim: GORGO improves p95 TTFT by 6.9-15.5% over baseline policies during held-out evaluation windows with fixed learned parameters.
evidence.condition: held-out evaluation window, fixed learned parameters

evidence.claim: GORGO improves p95 end-to-end latency by 14.3-30.9% over the same baselines.
Releases ART-Chat-2.5M, a synthetic dataset derived from long-context production metadata, because existing datasets lack long-context, high prefix-reuse data.
Uses evolutionary strategies on a tuning window from ART-Chat-2.5M to guide GORGO's parameters to optimize p95 TTFT.
GORGO holistically factors network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay using tunable parameters.

facts.evaluation_context: Cross-region LLM serving proxy; baselines include simple session affinity and prefix-cache policies; synthetic ART-Chat-2.5M dataset from long-context production metadata; evolutionary-strategy tuning; held-out evaluation with fixed learned params.
facts.limitations: Evaluation uses a synthetic dataset (ART-Chat-2.5M) rather than direct live traffic; abstract-level, full traffic patterns and generalization across providers require full text. Code/dataset released (CC BY 4.0) but not inspected here. Full body not fetched.
facts.project_relevance: Directly relevant to cross-region and KVCache concerns: it jointly optimizes KV-cache locality, network latency, and queueing delay in geographically distributed LLM serving, exactly the cross-region/KV-cache-routing problem space. The holistic latency+locality tuning and the released prefix-reuse dataset are actionable for multi-region serving and KVCache transfer scheduling.
